# ALEX MERCER
**Target Role:** Senior Senior AI Software Engineer | **Target Company:** ZipRecruiter Verified Partner
San Francisco, CA • +1 (555) 019-2834 • alex.mercer@example.com • linkedin.com/in/alex-mercer-ai • github.com/alex-mercer
---

## PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior AI and Distributed Systems Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable AI platforms using Python, FastAPI, LLMs, and Kubernetes. Proven track record of leading high-impact AI initiatives at Apex Autonomous Labs, modernizing cloud infrastructure on GCP, and deploying advanced retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. Expert in optimizing high-throughput microservices and machine learning workflows to deliver sub-millisecond inference latency and robust enterprise reliability.

## CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS
- **Programming Languages:** Python, TypeScript, SQL
- **Frameworks & APIs:** FastAPI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, PyTorch, TensorFlow
- **AI & ML Specialization:** Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG Architectures, Vector Databases (Pinecone, pgvector), Fine-tuning
- **Cloud & Infrastructure:** GCP (Google Cloud Platform), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD Pipelines
- **Databases & Storage:** PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB
- **Architecture & Methodologies:** Distributed Systems, Microservices, RESTful APIs, Asynchronous Programming, Agile/Scrum

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### Senior AI Software Engineer | Apex Autonomous Labs
*2022 - Present | San Francisco, CA*
- Accomplished a **40%** reduction in API response latency as measured by end-user monitoring tools by doing optimized asynchronous endpoint routing leveraging **Python** and **FastAPI**.
- Accomplished a **99.99%** system uptime across distributed multi-cluster deployments as measured by production telemetry by doing containerizing workloads with Docker and orchestrating services via Kubernetes on GCP.
- Accomplished a **35%** increase in natural language query accuracy as measured by benchmark evaluation datasets by doing integrating robust RAG architectures and LangChain frameworks with enterprise LLMs.
- Accomplished a **50%** decrease in cloud infrastructure operational overhead as measured by monthly billing reports by doing re-architecting data ingestion pipelines and database queries in PostgreSQL.

### AI Software Engineer | DataScale Systems
*2019 - 2022 | San Francisco, CA*
- Accomplished a **60%** acceleration in model deployment cycles as measured by CI/CD pipeline duration metrics by doing standardizing automated testing and containerization workflows using **Python** and Docker.
- Accomplished a **25%** boost in system throughput under peak load as measured by load testing benchmarks by doing developing high-performance microservices with **FastAPI** and asynchronous task queues.
- Accomplished a **30%** improvement in vector search retrieval speeds as measured by query response logs by doing implementing optimized indexing strategies within distributed PostgreSQL databases on GCP.

## EDUCATION & CREDENTIALS

### Master of Science in Computer Science | Stanford University
*2017 - 2019 | Stanford, CA*
- Focus on Artificial Intelligence and Distributed Systems.

### Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering | University of California, Berkeley
*2013 - 2017 | Berkeley, CA*
- Graduated with Honors; President of the Machine Learning Student Society.

### Certifications
- Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer
- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

hiring_manager_email.body:
Hi [Name],

Managing high-throughput distributed systems requires infrastructure that is as resilient as it is fast. I’ve been following Kong’s API gateway ecosystem and noticed the expansion of the Managed Gateways SRE team.

recruiter_inmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineering Manager, Managed Gateways SREs (Kong Inc.)
recruiter_inmail.body:
Hi [Name],

I recently applied for the Senior Software Engineering Manager, Managed Gateways SREs position at Kong Inc. and wanted to connect directly with the talent team. 

With over 3 years of engineering leadership experience deeply rooted in Python and FastAPI ecosystems, I specialize in building, scaling, and stabilizing high-availability gateway infrastructure. In my most recent leadership role, I guided an SRE organization through a massive architectural migration, cutting system downtime by 40% and accelerating deployment cadences. 

Kong’s work in modern API management is exceptional, and I am confident my background in reliability engineering and team enablement makes me an immediate asset to your SRE organization. 

Could you share a brief update on the review timeline for this requisition? 

Best regards,  
Alex Mercer  
[Link to LinkedIn]

referral_request.subject: Quick question regarding Kong's SRE culture / Alex Mercer
referral_request.body:
Hi [Name],

I hope this note finds you well. I’ve been following Kong’s engineering blog and am deeply impressed by how your team scales the Managed Gateways infrastructure. 

I’m an engineering manager with 3+ years of experience scaling Python and FastAPI systems, and I am currently exploring the Senior SRE Manager role on your team. 

Since you have firsthand insight into Kong’s engineering culture, would you be open to a 5-minute virtual coffee sometime next week? I’d love to ask you a couple of quick questions about team dynamics and engineering priorities before I finalize my interview prep. 

No pressure at all if bandwidth is tight, but I’d greatly appreciate your perspective. 

Best,  
Alex Mercer

thank_you_note.subject: Thank you / Senior SRE Manager discussion – Alex Mercer
thank_you_note.body:
Hi [Name],

Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today about the Senior Software Engineering Manager, Managed Gateways SREs role at Kong Inc. 

Our conversation regarding your team's upcoming roadmap for API gateway reliability and performance optimization was particularly exciting. It reinforced my belief that my background in scaling Python and FastAPI microservices aligns directly with the architectural challenges your team is solving. I was especially energized by our discussion on automating operational toil to empower SRE productivity—an initiative I’ve successfully driven in my previous leadership roles. 

I am confident in my ability to step in and lead this team to even greater reliability milestones. Please let me know if you need any additional artifacts or references from my side. 

I look forward to the next steps!

Best,  
Alex Mercer

discovered_jobs.full_description: About Mitre Media Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time. Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect! About the Role As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions. You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality. Responsibilities Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8) Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences. Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions. Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing. Required Technical Skills Back-End Ruby (5+ years, expert-level) Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred) PostgreSQL (or MySQL) Elasticsearch Redis Docker Front-End StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6 Tailwind CSS HTML HTTP AI Integration Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic) Nice-to-Have Technical Skills Kubernetes for microservices orchestration React for advanced front-end components Graph databases for complex financial data Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects Required Soft Skills Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code Team player comfortable as an individual contributor Why Join Us? Impactful Work : Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights. Cutting-Edge Tech : Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture. Autonomy and Influence : Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate. Competitive Compensation : $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits. Remote Flexibility : Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC Growth Opportunities : Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation. Dynamic Culture : Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech. About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data. How to Apply Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.
